verdict.rationale: Puzzle's first-party MCP server connects Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant directly to the live ledger. It exposes trial balance, cash activity, transactions, bills, payroll and spending metrics. The runway/forecast doc says affordability-style questions (burn, cash-out month, cash-flow forecast) can be answered by asking an AI assistant through the MCP against live books. Missing for 10: an explicit documented example of a specific 'can we afford X' purchase scenario (only runway/burn framing is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent answer quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Puzzle projects your cash from your live books: how long your cash lasts at your current burn, the month you'd run out, when to start raising, and a week-by-week cash flow forecast built from your open invoices, bills and payroll.
ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant through the Puzzle MCP

Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation — no exports, no copy-pasting.
